text: Provides comprehensive finite difference method solver 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations using Chorin’s fractional-step projection method pressure-velocity coupling. package implements efficient Rcpp/OpenMP-parallelised computational kernels convection, diffusion, pressure Poisson solvers Jacobi SOR (successive -relaxation) iterative methods. Features include multiple boundary condition types (Dirichlet, Neumann, periodic), external forcing support, comprehensive diagnostics (mass conservation, CFL monitoring), built-visualization functions velocity fields, vorticity, pressure distributions. title: Spatially localized forcing (vortex generation) — localized_vortex_force
text: forcing constructed rotational field Gaussian spatial localization. Defining \(r^2 = (x - x_0)^2 + (y - y_0)^2\), forcing components : $$f_x = -(y - y_0) \exp\left(-\frac{r^2}{\sigma^2}\right)$$ $$f_y = (x - x_0) \exp\left(-\frac{r^2}{\sigma^2}\right)$$ forcing injects positive (counter-clockwise) vorticity flow, curl forcing field given : $$\nabla \times \mathbf{f} = 2A\left(1 - \frac{r^2}{\sigma^2}\right)\exp\left(-\frac{r^2}{\sigma^2}\right)$$ parameter \(\sigma\) controls spatial extent forcing region, \(\) controls strength vorticity injection. type forcing useful studying vortex dynamics, wake formation, turbulence generation.

title: Single Gaussian vortex initial condition — single_vortex_ic
text: initial condition creates single Lamb-Oseen (Gaussian) vortex centered \((x_0, y_0)\). azimuthal velocity profile : $$u_\theta(r) = \frac{\Gamma}{2\pi\sigma}\frac{r}{\sigma}\exp\left(-\frac{r^2}{2\sigma^2}\right)$$ \(r = \sqrt{(x-x_0)^2 + (y-y_0)^2}\) radial distance vortex center. velocity field converted Cartesian components: $$u = -u_\theta \frac{(y - y_0)}{r}, \quad v = u_\theta \frac{(x - x_0)}{r}$$ Gaussian vortex several desirable properties: smooth center (avoiding \(1/r\) singularity point vortex), exactly divergence-free, analytical solution viscous decay. viscous diffusion, core radius grows \(\sigma(t) = \sqrt{\sigma_0^2 + 4\nu t}\) peak vorticity decays.

title: Taylor-Green vortex initial condition — vortex_ic
text: velocity field : $$u(x,y) = \sin(2\pi x / l_x) \cos(2\pi y / l_y)$$ $$v(x,y) = -\cos(2\pi x / l_x) \sin(2\pi y / l_y)$$ divergence-free construction. kinetic energy decays : $$E(t) = E_0 \exp(-2\nu (k_x^2 + k_y^2) t)$$ \(k_x = 2\pi/l_x\) \(k_y = 2\pi/l_y\). \(l_x = l_y\), simplifies \(E(t) = E_0 \exp(-4\nu k^2 t)\) \(k = 2\pi/l_x\). Note: sign convention used differs textbooks (use \(u = -\cos(kx)\sin(ky)\)), valid divergence-free fields. package's taylor_green_force matches convention.
